risk: A model-contract change could be mislabeled as implementation-compatible and preserve evidence that should be reopened.
An underdeclared exact consumer could leave downstream evidence current after its input identity changed.
A partially supplied evidence bundle could create mixed old and new validity if reconciliation were not transactional.
A targeted recovery read set could become too narrow if it omitted a changed target specification.
An over-broad relevance classifier could turn harmless cache drift into unnecessary R2 full recovery, while an under-broad classifier could leave a material unowned change in R1.
External semantic truth still depends on the author correctly declaring changed facets and exact consumers.
A ten-section structural check could be mistaken for proof that formulas, results, and boundaries are actually understandable or correct.
Binding S6 acceptance to one reviewed file could be overextended into reopening technical evidence for every later wording-only edit.
Parallel-window path ownership is a human-scoped coordination boundary; the current controller does not provide a distributed filesystem lock.
old_behavior: The state machine represented cross-question changes only as redesign or failure recovery, even when the model contract was unchanged.
A Q3 implementation insight propagated to Q1 and Q2 through serial component transitions, checkpoints, execution envelopes, evidence invalidation, and receipt closure.
The observed A-problem backport accumulated 48 control events across repeated replay groups while the implementation edit itself took only minutes.
R1 recovery reread dependency closures and broad evidence sets after each replay window.
A structurally valid state forced baseline-missing, incomplete-baseline, graph-drift, and unattributed workspace changes into R1 even when a bounded read scope could not be proven.
The inherited teammate brief rule allowed nine semantic checklist items, a shared document, no fixed filename, and explicitly did not participate in S6 closure.
The observed 2024 B project instead used one docs/q*/solution_brief.md per question, a ten-section modeling responsibility chain, and an actual human understanding stop before initial S6 closure.
new_observable_effects: G1 records one project-level compatible ChangeSet spanning all declared implementation targets and direct consumers without mutating lifecycle state.
G2 validates and installs every declared replacement evidence item in one transaction and emits one reconciliation event inside one execution envelope.
All affected components retain their S4-S7 lifecycle state; only declared post-spec evidence levels receive new validity identities.
A missing replacement, undeclared exact consumer, model-contract facet, changed baseline state, or stale prefix rejects the whole transaction with no partial commit.
R1 rereads target specifications and changed paths while unchanged official inputs and frozen process bindings are checked by identity.

R0 now requires proven same-window continuity, R1 requires a complete trusted baseline plus attributable delta and provable consumer closure, and every unproven case escalates to R2 full-project recovery.
G1 teammate-brief writing now requires docs/<task-id>/solution_brief.md and a ten-section complete modeling narrative; engineering reproduction stays in optional sidecars.

S6 closure selects the teammate-brief rule and binds the actual human read/restatement decision to the reviewed file, while S7 wording-only synchronization remains G1 and does not reopen technical evidence.

Cross-question continuity is expressed locally through analysis, formula reuse, and degradation tests; parallel windows use disjoint write surfaces and one explicitly designated authoritative-state writer.
preserved: V15 route, atom, capability, platform, receipt, artifact, and lifecycle contracts remain the inherited base envelope.
Scope, model specification, and selection rationale are never eligible compatible-change affected levels.
Implementation targets must refresh implementation_ref, E1, and E2; lifecycle-required evidence must be current after reconciliation.
Model, constraint, objective, data-semantic, or prefix changes still reopen at the earliest changed lifecycle layer.
V15.0.1 remains available as an isolated rollback tree and is not modified by this candidate.
A new or unknown window still excludes R0, and R2 still authorizes recovery reading and control reconstruction rather than solver execution or result recomputation.
The teammate brief remains technical documentation rather than a manuscript, E1-E4 remain the technical verification axes, and optional implementation/verification sidecars remain demand-driven.
retired_or_merged: Per-component lifecycle replay for a single compatible cross-component implementation backport is replaced by one project-level overlay.
Repeated per-component receipts are merged into one atomic compatible-change reconciliation receipt.
Coarse transitive-consumer invalidation is replaced inside this lane by exact declared consumer and artifact-reference checks.
Broad dependency-closure rereads are replaced inside this lane by a target, source-anchor, and changed-path recovery set.
The catch-all rule that classified any workspace delta or a missing baseline as R1 is replaced by machine-checkable R1 eligibility and same-episode R1-to-R2 escalation.
The nine-item, shared-document, no-fixed-name teammate handoff is replaced by one canonical ten-section modeling brief per substantive question.
File existence and static format checks are retired as substitutes for the actual S6 human read and restatement decision.
unverified: The controller cannot independently prove that an author's compatibility classification is mathematically true.
Mixed implementation and specification edits remain intentionally outside the fast path until split or reopened.
External tools and operating-system side effects remain governed by their existing controls rather than this overlay.
The historical A-problem project was used as evidence but was not rewritten in place by the candidate.
The structural brief validator cannot prove mathematical correctness, current result identity, honest claim boundaries, or that a human truly understood the reviewed text.
The historical 2024 B project was read as design evidence and was not modified or retroactively rebound to the V16 controller.
The 2025 A live rollout and project were inspected read-only; V16 cannot guarantee another process will respect its declared write surface without external coordination.
Recovery read receipts prove declared coverage and exact identities but cannot by themselves prove that every semantic interpretation made during a human or model read was correct.

impact_surfaces.effect: Represent one Q3-to-Q1/Q2 compatible implementation idea as one sealed multi-component ChangeSet without lifecycle mutation.
Install all declared replacement evidence at one revision and reject incomplete bundles or component-validity drift without a reconciliation commit.
Reject omitted protected registered deltas and changed path, artifact, or typed-claim bindings that reach any undeclared or preserved consumer.
Keep unprotected working artifacts outside the batch unless a current exact evidence binding actually references their changed identity.
Reuse the model-contract prefix only while each current record still matches its live evidence identity.
Use semantic reads only for changed targets and paths while unchanged project identities remain identity checks.

Keep R0 receipt-free in a proven uninterrupted window, admit R1 only with complete baseline, attribution, and closure proofs, and use one full-project R2 episode for every unbounded or explicit-full case.
Bind the V16 candidate to its own drivers while retaining the complete V15 required scenario envelope and rollback tree.
Write one ten-section modeling brief at docs/<task-id>/solution_brief.md with a lightweight G1 edit path, then select its exact human understanding obligation only when closing S6.

rollback_identity.strategy: Keep the isolated V15.0.1 tree unchanged; if V16 acceptance fails, discard the V16 candidate and continue from that bound tree.
